title: Friday Fish Fry
metaTitle: Friday Fish Fry — Amber Inn, Eau Claire
metaDescription: The Amber Inn's Friday fish fry at 840 E Madison St, Eau Claire: two pieces of hand-breaded cod, two sides and a breadstick, $9.49, 11 AM until sold out. Wisconsin's oldest tavern.

data.title: Fish Fry
data.description: Two pieces of hand-breaded cod with two sides and a breadstick. Starts at 11 in the morning and runs until it is gone.
details: Walk in. No reservations, no platform, no fee.
$9.49. Two pieces of hand-breaded cod, two sides, a breadstick.
Until sold out — on a good Friday that is before the supper crowd.

data.heading: Make it a Friday
data.subtitle: Ten taps, heavy on German imports, and draft root beer in an iced mug for the kids.
